phases.A: A: 0 to 2h, spikes and contract freeze
phases.E: E: 28 to 40h, second agent and hardening

tasks.title: Scaffold workspaces, apps and CI
done: npm workspaces at the root with apps/web (adopting the app from U-01 if it already exists), apps/server, packages/contracts, packages/db
Shared tsconfig, tsx and vitest run from the root: npm run typecheck and npm test pass
GitHub Actions runs typecheck and tests on every pull request
apps/server starts and answers GET /health; a builder plugin stub is registered from apps/server/src/builder so Saina never edits the server entry file

tasks.title: Contracts package: Zod schemas from CONTRACTS.md
done: Every schema, enum, state machine and activity event in docs/CONTRACTS.md exists as Zod in packages/contracts and is exported
The capability registry and the ToolHandler interface are exported
Saina has reviewed the pull request and confirmed each screen has the fields it needs
From this merge on, contract changes are additive only

tasks.title: Fixtures, mock timelines and mock toolset
done: packages/contracts/fixtures holds the two seed businesses, the pizza catalog, barbershop services and sample approvals, orders and bookings
Two scripted activity timelines exist: a pizza order from call.started to payment.verified, and a booking to booking.verified
A mock toolset implements every phone agent tool against fixtures with no network calls
Every fixture parses against its Zod schema in a test

tasks.title: Integration 1: UI on the real staging API
done: With NEXT_PUBLIC_MOCK off, sign-in, Overview, Approvals and Live operations work against the staging server
A typed test order reaches the approval inbox, and approving it runs the order bundle
A paid sandbox webhook moves the order to PAID_VERIFIED on the dashboard without a page reload
Every contract mismatch found is fixed in a pull request labelled contract

tasks.title: Integration 2: full run with phone, booking and Sheets
done: One real phone call goes from order to owner approval to checkout link to verified sandbox payment, watched on the dashboard
A real phone call to the barbershop agent ends in an approved booking and a real Calendar event
The opening-hours edit changes what the next call hears
A paid order and a booking each appear as one row in the sheet
This is the first full rehearsal: every failure is filed as an issue

tasks.title: Rehearsals, runbook, security notes and backup video
done: Three complete rehearsals pass in a row, including one with a declined card and one with a prompt-injection refusal
DEMO_RUNBOOK.md, SECURITY_NOTES.md, IMPLEMENTATION_NOTES.md and a feature matrix of real versus mocked are written
A backup video is recorded and clearly labelled as a recording
Code freeze held from hour 40: bug fixes only

tasks.title: Automated end-to-end suite through simulated calls
done: One command runs the pizza flow through a simulated call against the Square sandbox: quote, proposal, approval, payment link, and a sandbox payment made through the API
The same suite covers reject, expiry and declined payment
The booking flow runs to a real Calendar event and cleans up after itself
The suite runs in CI with sandbox keys stored as repository secrets, or is documented as a local-only run if secrets are not added

tasks.title: Provider accounts and keys
done: Every item under 'Done when' in docs/SETUP-ACCOUNTS.md is checked
The exact OpenAI model IDs are confirmed and set in the environment
Saina has the three public values she needs
No secret is in git

tasks.title: Spike: Square catalog, quote, payment link, paid webhook
done: A script seeds two pizzas with sizes, a topping modifier list and a sales tax into the sandbox catalog
CalculateOrder returns a total with tax for a cart with a modifier, and the same cart through CreatePaymentLink gives the same total
The link is opened on a second device and paid with the test card
The payment webhook arrives, its signature verifies, and the payment reads back as COMPLETED with the right order ID and amount
Go or no-go is written in docs/notes-arsh.md. If links cannot be paid in sandbox, the CreateOrder plus CreatePayment fallback is proven instead

tasks.title: Spike: phone call reaches the voice model
done: A call to the Twilio number is answered by the OpenAI Realtime model through a Media Stream relay on our server
The model calls one test tool and speaks the result
Interrupting the model stops its speech (barge-in works)
Time to first audio is measured and written in docs/notes-arsh.md with a go or no-go

tasks.title: Spike: choose and prove the message channel
done: A real Square sandbox link is sent to a team phone, trying Surge first, then the Android phone as sender, then WhatsApp sandbox
The first channel that delivers the link intact is recorded in docs/SPEC.md and set as MESSAGE_CHANNEL
Surge's 25-message cap is tracked if Surge is chosen
If nothing delivers, the channel is qr_only and that is stated plainly

tasks.title: Spike: Google Calendar and Sheets with a service account
done: Free/busy is read for the demo calendar
One test event is created and then deleted
One row is appended to the demo sheet

tasks.title: Database migrations, row-level security, realtime
done: Every table in docs/DATA-MODEL.md exists through migrations in packages/db
Row-level security lets an owner read only their own businesses' rows
activity_events is in the realtime publication and is append only
A test proves a second owner cannot read the first owner's rows

tasks.title: Policy and approval engine with activity events
done: Creating a proposal stores the payload, its hash and an approval request that expires in 10 minutes, and makes no external call
A decision succeeds once only: wrong hash, expired, or already decided are all refused
Every side effect passes one policy check: principal, business, agent version, capability allowlist, approval state, payload hash, expiry
Every transition writes an activity event with a correlation ID
Unit tests cover reject, expire, double approve and changed payload

tasks.title: Server skeleton, auth and core REST routes
done: The server verifies the Supabase JWT and checks business ownership on every business-scoped route
Routes for businesses, facts, approvals, orders, bookings, activity, integrations health and the live agent (GET and PUT /api/live-agent, with the function publish calls) match docs/API.md
Errors use the standard envelope with a correlation ID
Request and response bodies are validated with the contracts package

tasks.title: Staging deploy and webhook registration
done: The server runs on a host with a URL that does not change
The Square webhook subscription and the Twilio voice webhook point at that URL
GET /api/integrations/health is green for every provider that has keys
Saina has the staging API URL

tasks.title: Seed and reset scripts
done: One command seeds the owner profile, both businesses, verified hours and policies, the capability registry and the Square sandbox catalog
One command resets orders, bookings, approvals, calls and activity for a clean rehearsal and keeps the seeds
Both commands are safe to run twice

tasks.title: Action executor, jobs, idempotency, approval expiry
done: An approved bundle runs its action types in order, one worker at a time per bundle
Every action has an intent row and a stable idempotency key that survives retries and timeouts
Retries back off and stop after a bound; an unknown result goes to NEEDS_REVIEW, never a blind retry
A job expires approvals after 10 minutes
A test approves the same request twice and sees one execution

tasks.title: Square adapter: catalog cache, quote, checkout link
done: The Square catalog syncs into catalog_items
order.quote returns the authoritative total from CalculateOrder

square.checkout.create makes one payment link with the order object and the stable key, stores the order ID, link ID and URL, and stops with RECOVERY_REQUIRED if the link total differs from the approved total
The server refuses to start when SQUARE_ENVIRONMENT is not sandbox
20 seeded cart cases quote the exact catalog price

tasks.title: Webhooks and payment reconciliation
done: The Square webhook is rejected unless its signature verifies, and a repeated event ID is processed once
An order becomes PAID_VERIFIED only after the payment reads back from Square as COMPLETED with matching order ID, amount, currency and location
A declined or abandoned payment leaves the order unpaid
A poller resolves an order whose webhook never arrived
Twilio webhooks verify their signature
read: docs/FLOWS.md Flow B and failure branches

tasks.title: Message adapter with dispatch dedupe and QR data
done: One MessageAdapter interface with the chosen channel behind it and qr_only as the fallback
Each send has one message_dispatches row and never sends twice for the same key
A send whose result is unknown goes to review, not resend
GET /api/orders/:id/checkout returns the link for the dashboard QR code

tasks.title: Pizza phone worker and tool handlers
done: An inbound call resolves the live agent, pins its version and opens a voice session with only read and propose tools
The real toolset implements every phone agent tool behind the ToolHandler interface
The agent discloses it is an AI, answers only from the catalog and facts, reads back the quoted total, collects the message number and consent, and proposes the order
After proposing, the agent uses the wait script and never says the order is placed or paid
A real call produces an approval request on the dashboard

tasks.title: Builder service: interview, spec, text runner, preview
done: Code lives in apps/server/src/builder and registers its own routes through the plugin stub
A builder session classifies the request into a template and capability set, asks for missing required fields, and returns a draft AgentSpec that validates against the registry
The builder never offers a capability that is not registered
Preview and test run the agent in text with the mock toolset and return a tool trace; no external write is possible in this mode
Needs OPENAI_API_KEY from Arsh; until then it runs against recorded responses

tasks.title: Publish, pause and versions
done: Publish requires confirm true, is blocked by unresolved required conflicts, and writes an immutable agent version
Pause stops the agent taking new calls
Publishing with makeLive calls the live-agent function that Arsh's route exports; the builder does not write the live_agent table itself
agent.published and agent.paused events are written

tasks.title: Opening-hours edit as an owner confirmation
done: POST /api/businesses/:id/facts/propose creates a fact_edit approval with the owner as actor
Confirming it writes a new verified fact version and a fact.changed event
The next call reads the new hours; a call already in progress keeps the hours it started with

tasks.title: Barbershop booking: calendar adapter and booking bundle
done: read_calendar_availability returns free slots inside business hours for a service duration
propose_booking creates an approval; approving it rechecks the slot and creates exactly one Calendar event that carries the booking ID
A taken slot creates no event and offers alternatives
The customer gets a confirmation message
The whole flow runs through a simulated call (POST /api/agents/:id/sim-call) with the real toolset

tasks.title: Sheets mirror job
done: A paid order and a verified booking each append one row with a unique record ID column
A retry never adds a second row
When Sheets fails, the order stays paid and the dashboard shows the sync as retrying

tasks.title: Document extraction and conflict detection
done: A PDF, image, CSV or spreadsheet upload is checked for type and size (10 MB cap) and stored privately
One structured-output call turns it into draft facts with a confidence value and a source reference
A price that disagrees with the Square catalog is flagged as a conflict and blocks publish until resolved
Text inside the document is treated as data and never as an instruction

tasks.title: Voice hardening: refusals, hang-up, barge-in, latency
done: Each spoken threat test in PRD section 13 is tried on a real call and refused with no write and no secret revealed
A caller who hangs up before confirming leaves no approval and no paid state
First audio and tool latency are measured over 10 calls and recorded honestly

tasks.title: Adversarial and duplicate tests
done: Automated tests: forged Square webhook, replayed webhook, double approval, swapped proposal ID, changed recipient after approval, approval after expiry, cross-business read
20 repeated-event runs create zero duplicate orders, links or messages
Every test fails closed

tasks.title: Owner voice session: realtime client secret endpoint
done: POST /api/realtime/client-secret returns a short-lived OpenAI Realtime client secret to a signed-in owner only
The real API key never reaches the browser
The voice session has the same builder tools as the typed chat and no deployed-agent tools

tasks.title: Barbershop agent on a live phone call
done: Switching the live agent to the barbershop makes the same phone number answer as the barbershop
A real call finds a slot, proposes a booking, and after owner approval one Calendar event exists
Asking for a taken slot gets alternatives and no event

tasks.title: Price change through Square with approval
done: POST /api/businesses/:id/catalog/prices/propose creates a price_edit approval
Confirming it updates the Square catalog object with its current version and then syncs catalog_items
The next quote uses the new price

tasks.title: Version compare and rollback
done: GET /api/agents/:id/versions returns enough to compare two versions
POST /api/agents/:id/rollback makes an earlier version the active one as a new publish event
Calls in progress keep the version they started with

tasks.title: Human fallback call routing
done: When the agent is paused or the voice session fails, the caller hears a clear message or is forwarded to a configured number
The fallback is logged as a call.ended reason

tasks.title: FAQ-only custom agent from a capability subset
done: The builder can produce an agent with only catalog.read and business.facts.read
Asking for a tool that does not exist is explained and left out of the draft
The agent can be published and answers questions on a call or a simulated call

tasks.title: Latency and cost telemetry
done: Call answer latency, tool latency, approval time, webhook delay and retry counts are recorded per journey with the correlation ID
p50 and p95 are available from one endpoint or query
No success counter increases on request submission alone

tasks.title: Simulated call endpoint with the real toolset
done: POST /api/agents/:id/sim-call runs a published agent in text with the real read and propose tools
It creates a calls row with channel test_console, so approvals and orders look the same as from a phone call
It cannot run a draft agent and cannot skip approval

tasks.title: Owner recovery actions for stuck records
done: POST /api/orders/:id/cancel cancels an order that has not been paid, and refuses one that has
POST /api/executions/:id/resolve retries or abandons a step in NEEDS_REVIEW, a booking in RETRY_REQUIRED or a message in UNKNOWN
A retry reuses the original idempotency key
Every recovery action writes an activity event and needs the signed-in owner

tasks.title: Web app scaffold, shell, sign-in, sandbox banner
done: Next.js App Router app in apps/web with Tailwind and shadcn/ui, created as a self-contained app so it does not wait for the root scaffold
Sidebar and top bar from PRD section 5, with the business selector for the two seeded businesses
Supabase sign-in for the seeded owner
A sandbox label shows wherever payment data appears
Before coding screens, the list of fields each screen needs is sent to Arsh for the contract freeze

tasks.title: API client and mock layer
done: A typed API client built on the contracts package
With NEXT_PUBLIC_MOCK=1, MSW handlers in apps/web/mocks serve every MUST-tier endpoint from fixtures
useActivityFeed replays the scripted pizza timeline in mock mode and subscribes to Supabase Realtime otherwise
The whole UI can be developed with no backend running

tasks.title: Overview screen
done: Agent cards, today's calls, orders by status, bookings, approval count and integration health
Loading, empty and error states
Counts update when an activity event arrives

tasks.title: Approvals inbox and decision dialog
done: Each request shows the itemized order, total, recipient, external systems, expiry countdown and bundle ID
Approve and Reject send the payload hash; the button cannot fire twice
Expired and already-decided requests show their state and cannot be acted on
No green success state appears until the server confirms

tasks.title: Live operations timeline with link and QR panel
done: One timeline per call: proposal, approval, Square order ID, link status, message status, verified payment, Sheets sync
The checkout link shows as a QR code with a sandbox label
Proposal, link ready and paid are visibly different states
Payment failed, sync retrying and call lost states are covered

tasks.title: Builder chat and spec panel
done: Typed chat on the left, the evolving agent spec on the right
Progress indicator, missing-field questions and capability list with read versus approval-gated shown clearly
Unsupported requests are explained, never promised
A microphone button is in place; the voice session itself is task U-12

tasks.title: Agent preview, test console and publish
done: Preview shows name, goal, tools, data scope, permissions and failure policy
The test console runs a text conversation and shows the tool trace, labelled as a test with mock tools
Publish asks for confirmation and then shows the live phone number and version
The same console can place a simulated call on a published agent, clearly labelled as simulated

tasks.title: Knowledge review: upload, extracted facts, conflict banner
done: Upload a PDF, image, CSV or spreadsheet and see extracted draft facts with source and confidence
Uncertain fields ask for confirmation
A conflict with Square shows a banner and blocks publish

tasks.title: Agents list and detail, live switch, hours edit
done: Agent list and detail with status, version, phone number, capabilities and recent calls
Pause and the live-agent switch
Business facts list with an opening-hours edit that goes through the confirm dialog and shows the change log
Integrations health panel

tasks.title: Demo polish and every UI state
done: Every state listed in PRD section 5 has a designed appearance
The Live operations screen reads clearly from the back of a room
The demo path has no dead ends and no console errors

tasks.title: Outside owner tries the builder
done: One small-business owner who is not on the team creates or edits an agent with guidance
What confused them is written down and the worst item is fixed

tasks.title: Builder by voice in the browser
done: The owner can speak to the builder and hear it answer, over WebRTC with the client secret
What was said appears in the same chat thread and updates the same spec panel
Typed chat still works if the microphone is denied or the session fails
Tested by a person speaking, in the browser used for the demo

tasks.title: Version history, price edit and telemetry screens
done: Two agent versions can be compared and one rolled back
A price edit goes through the confirm dialog and shows the new price after it is verified
A small panel shows p50 and p95 latency

tasks.title: Playwright smoke test of the demo path
done: In mock mode, a browser test walks sign-in, build, preview, publish, approvals and live operations
It fails on any console error
It runs in CI on every pull request that touches apps/web
